comun.sinPermiso: You don’t have permission to do that.
comun.entrarPrimero: Sign in with Discord to continue.
grupos.nota: The groups you belong to. Each group uploads its raids and decides what is public.
grupos.vacio: You’re not in any group yet. Create one or ask your group for an invite link.
grupos.slug.ayuda: Lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens only (3 to 40). It will be /g/your-address.
grupos.error.nombre: The name must be 2 to 60 characters long.
grupos.error.slug: That address isn’t valid: use lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens (3 to 40), not starting or ending with a hyphen.
grupos.error.slugOcupado: Another group already uses that address. Try a different one.
grupo.oculto: Hidden group: only its members can see it.
grupo.publico: Group listed on the home page.
grupo.raids.vacio: This group hasn’t uploaded any raids yet.
ajustes.visible: Show the group on the home page and in search
ajustes.invitaciones.nota: Share the link with whoever you want to join. They join with the invite’s role.
unirse.texto: You’re invited to join the group as {rol}.
unirse.invalida: This invite doesn’t exist, has expired or has no uses left. Ask whoever sent it for a new link.
unirse.entrar: Sign in with Discord to accept the invite.
noEncontrado.texto: This page doesn’t exist or you don’t have access to it. If it belongs to a private group, sign in with the Discord account you joined with.
portada.lede: Aion 2 raid history by group, taken from the Questlog combat meter: stats for every night, player profiles and analysis.
portada.grupos.nota: Groups that share their raids. Private raids are only visible to members.
portada.crear: Create one for your group, or join with an invite from “My groups”.
subir.lede: Choose your Questlog folder and the night you want to upload. Everything is calculated in your browser: only your group’s stats reach the site.
subir.sinPermiso: You need the publisher role (or higher) in this group to upload raids.
subir.cargandoMotor: Getting the processor ready (the first time it downloads about 7 MB)…
subir.errorMotor: The processor couldn’t start. Reload the page; if it keeps failing, try desktop Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
subir.paso1.ayuda: It’s in %APPDATA%\Questlog\aion-2. In the picker, paste that path into the address bar and press “Upload” or “Select folder”. Your browser will ask for permission to read it: only Questlog’s files are read.
subir.errorCarpeta: That doesn’t look like the Questlog folder (no runs/ or encounters/). Choose %APPDATA%\Questlog\aion-2.
subir.paso2.nota: Most recent runs first. Runs with 8 or more players are raids.
subir.errorProcesar: This run couldn’t be calculated. If it happens with others too, let us know the run’s name.
subir.privacidad: Only your group’s players are stored (outsiders don’t appear). Choose who can see it; you can change it later.
subir.duplicada: This night is already uploaded in the group as “{slug}” (maybe someone else recorded it). Replace it with this one?
subir.errorFormato: The server didn’t accept the data: {detalle}
subir.errorSesion: Your session expired. Sign in with Discord again and re-upload it.
subir.errorRed: Couldn’t send it. Check your connection and try again.
subir.hecho.actualizada: Raid updated (it was already uploaded and has been replaced with this data).
ajustes.tokens: Tokens to publish from your PC
ajustes.tokens.nota: With a token, nueva-raid.bat (tools/publicar.ps1) uploads this group’s raids without opening the browser. It acts as a publisher. Keep it on your PC: it’s only shown once.
ajustes.tokens.nuevo: Copy this token now; it won’t be shown again:
ajustes.tokens.confirmar: Revoke the token “{n}”? Anything using it will no longer be able to publish.
ajustes.borrar.nota: Its {n} raids, their analyses, the profiles written for the group, the members, invitations and tokens are deleted forever. This can’t be undone.
ajustes.borrar.confirmar: Delete “{n}” and all its raids forever? This can’t be undone.
ajustes.borrar.noCoincide: What you typed doesn’t match the group’s address.
ia.enCurso: Analyzing with AI… it takes 1 to 3 minutes; the page will update by itself.
ia.espera: This raid was already analyzed with AI; it can be analyzed again on {d}.
ia.listo: AI analysis done; it can be repeated on {d}.
ia.error: The AI analysis couldn’t be done. Try again in a few minutes.
ia.confirmar: This raid already has an analysis. Replace it with a new AI analysis? It can’t be repeated for 24 hours afterwards.
ajustes.webhook.nota: With a Discord webhook, anyone who looks up their name on the group page can press “Request my profile analysis” and the notice reaches that channel (at most one every 10 minutes per player). Create it in Discord: Channel settings → Integrations → Webhooks. The address is stored encrypted and is never shown again.
ajustes.webhook.vacio: No webhook: the “Request analysis” button is hidden.
ajustes.webhook.confirmarQuitar: Remove the webhook? The “Request analysis” button will be hidden.
ajustes.webhook.invalido: That doesn’t look like a Discord webhook address (https://discord.com/api/webhooks/…).
ajustes.webhook.inexistente: Discord doesn’t recognise that webhook. Check that you copied all of it and that it hasn’t been deleted.
solicitud.cifras: {raids} raids ({kills} with a kill) · average DPS {dps} · average HPS {hps} · {m} deaths per attempt · GS {gs}
solicitud.ultima: Last raid: {d} · Profile written by Claude: {p}
